name.zh: 北京绕城高速公路（六环路）

tagline.en: A ring about 25 km out from the centre of Beijing, built in seven phases over eleven years, with its eastern side now put underground through the city's new sub-centre
tagline.zh: 距北京市中心约 25 公里的一条环线，分七期、历时十一年建成；东段如今已在城市副中心地下穿行

start.en: Suanzaoling interchange with the Beijing–Chengde expressway, Changping district — kilometre 0 of the ring
start.zh: 昌平区酸枣岭桥，接京承高速——环线零公里点

end.en: Back at Suanzaoling, about 196 km round. G4501 is a closed ring; the two ends the page shows are the same point
end.zh: 绕行约 196 公里后回到酸枣岭桥。G4501 是闭合环线，页面所示的起终点是同一处

en: G4501 is the outermost of Beijing's ring roads, about 25 km from the city centre. It passes through nine of the city's districts and links seven new towns — Shunyi, Tongzhou, Yizhuang, Daxing, Fangshan, Mentougou and Changping — and, when it was finished in 2009, every radial national road out of Beijing and twelve radial expressways. Beijing's transport commission described it then as a freight corridor first: its job is to catch through traffic and lorries before they reach the city.

As a ring it has no termini. The chainage starts at Suanzaoling in Changping, where it meets the Beijing–Chengde expressway, and runs clockwise through Shunyi, Tongzhou, Daxing and Fangshan, over the hills on the west side through Mentougou and back through Haidian and Changping. From Suanzaoling to the Shuangyuan interchange with the Beijing–Kaifeng expressway in Daxing it carries G45, the Daqing–Guangzhou expressway, as well.
zh: G4501 是北京最外围的一条环路，距市中心约 25 公里。它穿越北京市 9 个区，连接顺义、通州、亦庄、大兴、房山、门头沟、昌平 7 个新城；2009 年全线贯通时，与北京所有放射线国道和 12 条放射线高速公路相连。北京市交通委当时把它首先定位为货运交通大通道：在过境车辆和货车进城之前将其截流、疏导。
作为环线，它没有起终点。里程桩号自昌平区酸枣岭桥起算，在此与京承高速相接，按顺时针方向经顺义、通州、大兴、房山，翻越西部山区经门头沟，再经海淀、昌平回到起点。自酸枣岭桥至大兴区与京开高速相交的双源桥一段，同时为 G45 大广高速。

en: The ring was designed for 80 to 100 km/h, with four to six lanes and a continuous hard shoulder on a roadbed 26 to 28.5 metres wide, according to the builder, the Beijing Capital Highway Development Group, as cited in Chinese Wikipedia. The last phase, the 38.28 km of the west side from Liangxiang to Zhaikou, was the most difficult: it crosses the hills of Fangshan, Fengtai, Mentougou and Shijingshan with one extra-large bridge, eight interchanges, a twin-bore tunnel and six railway crossings, and is limited to 80 to 100 km/h for safety rather than the usual expressway 120.

The largest work since is underground. To let the streets of the Tongzhou sub-centre run across the line, the east side from the Beijing–Harbin expressway to Luyuan North Street, 16.3 km, was rebuilt from four lanes to six between 2019 and 2025: 7.1 km widened at ground level and about 9.2 km put into a tunnel. The tunnel's bored section, about 7.37 km, was dug by two 16.07-metre shield machines and is described by the municipal government as the longest shield-driven expressway tunnel in China. The old viaduct has been kept as an elevated park.
zh: 据建设单位北京市首发高速公路建设管理有限责任公司（中文维基百科引）介绍，全线设计速度 80—100 公里/小时，双向四至六车道加连续停车带，路基宽 26—28.5 米。最后一期西六环良乡至寨口段全长 38.28 公里，施工难度最大：途经房山、丰台、门头沟、石景山的山区，设特大桥 1 座、互通式立交 8 座、隧道 1 处 2 座，与铁路相交 6 处；出于安全考虑，设计时速为 80—100 公里，而非一般高速公路的 120 公里。
此后最大的工程在地下。为让通州城市副中心的东西向道路贯通，东六环自京哈高速至潞苑北大街的 16.3 公里于 2019 至 2025 年间由双向四车道改造为六车道：其中路基加宽段约 7.1 公里，入地隧道段约 9.2 公里。隧道中的盾构段约 7.37 公里，由两台直径 16.07 米的盾构机掘进，北京市政府称其为目前国内最长的盾构高速公路隧道。原有高架桥则保留下来，改建为高线公园。

en: Work began in December 1998, and the ring was built in seven phases over eleven years. By the dates in Chinese Wikipedia, the south-east side opened in 2001, the north side from the Badaling expressway to the Beijing–Miyun road in October 2002, the south-west side from the Beijing–Kaifeng to the Beijing–Shijiazhuang expressway on 20 December 2004, and the north-west side from Xishatun to Zhaikou in Mentougou on 27 December 2006. The last phase, Liangxiang–Zhaikou, was begun in 2007 — in July by the municipal housing commission's account, in November by the Beijing Times' — and opened on 12 September 2009. Xinhua called the 187.6 km ring the longest city ring expressway then built in China.

From 1 October 2009 vehicles below the emission standard, the 'yellow-label' cars and lorries, were banned from inside the ring. The rebuilding of the east side, a key project of the Tongzhou sub-centre, began on 30 November 2019. The tunnel opened at 04:00 on 20 April 2025 and the surface road it replaced was closed; the first 1.7 km of the park on the old viaduct opened on 29 April 2026.
zh: 六环路 1998 年 12 月开工，分七期建设，历时 11 年。按中文维基百科所列日期，东南段于 2001 年通车，八达岭高速至京密路段于 2002 年 10 月通车，京开高速至京石高速段于 2004 年 12 月 20 日通车，西沙屯至门头沟寨口段于 2006 年 12 月 27 日通车。最后一期良乡至寨口段于 2007 年开工——北京市住房城乡建设委称 7 月，《京华时报》称 11 月——2009 年 9 月 12 日建成通车。新华社称，全长 187.6 公里的六环路是当时国内最长的环城高速公路。
自 2009 年 10 月 1 日起，尾气排放不达标的“黄标车”禁止进入六环路以内。作为北京城市副中心重点工程，东六环改造工程于 2019 年 11 月 30 日开工。2025 年 4 月 20 日 4 时，东六环隧道开通试运营，被其取代的地面路段同时封闭；在原东六环高架上建成的公园首段 1.7 公里于 2026 年 4 月 29 日开放。

en: Beijing published a figure for the whole ring: 18.1 billion yuan, which China News Service put at about 100 million yuan a kilometre. The last phase alone, 38.28 km through the western hills, cost 8.48 billion. The rebuilding of the east side, 16.3 km with its tunnel, has a total investment of 11.7 billion yuan, nearly two-thirds of the cost of the whole original ring.

The ring is tolled; on the west side the tolls were set at the same rates as on the earlier east side. Construction was managed by the Beijing Capital Highway Development Group, a municipal company, which also led the east-side rebuilding.
zh: 北京公布过整条环线的造价：总投资 181 亿元，中新社称每公里造价约 1 亿元。仅穿越西部山区的最后一期 38.28 公里就投资 84.8 亿元。东六环改造工程全长 16.3 公里（含隧道），总投资 117 亿元，接近原六环路全线造价的三分之二。
六环路为收费公路；西六环的收费标准与先期开通的东六环一致。工程由市属的北京市首都公路发展集团有限公司负责建设，东六环改造工程也由首发集团牵头实施。

en: The ring is designed for 80 to 100 km/h, not the usual 120. The east-side tunnel is designed for 80 km/h, at which it takes about seven minutes; in its first two months it carried an average of 68,000 vehicles a day. Since 20 April 2025 lorries of 12 tonnes or more and vehicles carrying dangerous chemicals are banned at all hours from the stretch between Xiaopanggezhuang and Shiyuan, which includes the tunnel.
zh: 全线设计速度为 80—100 公里/小时，而非一般的 120 公里。东六环隧道设计时速 80 公里，按此车速通过约需 7 分钟；开通后前两个月日均交通量 6.8 万辆次。自 2025 年 4 月 20 日起，东六环小庞各庄桥至施园桥路段（含隧道）全天禁止总质量 12 吨及以上的载货汽车和运载危险化学品车辆驶入。

value.en: 18.1 billion yuan total investment for the original ring, built in seven phases from 1998 to 2009 — about 100 million yuan a kilometre
value.zh: 原六环路总投资 181 亿元，1998—2009 年分七期建成，每公里约 1 亿元

figures.source: China News Service, 12 September 2009; Beijing Capital Highway Development Group, as cited in Chinese Wikipedia, 北京六环路
Beijing Municipal Commission of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, 14 September 2009
Xinhua, reposted by the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission

why.en: No breakdown of who paid has been found. The ring was built and the east side rebuilt by the Beijing Capital Highway Development Group, a municipal state-owned company, and the road is tolled.
why.zh: 未查到出资构成。六环路的建设和东六环改造均由市属国有企业北京市首都公路发展集团有限公司承担，全线收费。

value.en: 187.6 km at completion in 2009; 196 km in the builder's later figure
value.zh: 2009 年贯通时为 187.6 公里；建设单位后来给出 196 公里

figures.source: Beijing Municipal Commission of Transport, 14 September 2009; Beijing Capital Highway Development Group, as cited in Chinese Wikipedia, 北京六环路

timeline.en: Work on the ring begins in December.
The north side, from the Badaling expressway to the Beijing–Miyun road, opens in October.
timeline.zh: 10 月，八达岭高速至京密路段通车。

timeline.en: The south-west side opens on 20 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 20 日，西南六环通车。

timeline.en: Xishatun–Zhaikou on the north-west side opens on 27 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 27 日，西沙屯至寨口段通车。

timeline.en: Liangxiang–Zhaikou opens on 12 September and the ring is complete; on 1 October 'yellow-label' vehicles are banned inside it.
timeline.zh: 9 月 12 日，良乡至寨口段通车，六环路全线贯通；10 月 1 日起，“黄标车”禁止进入六环以内。

timeline.en: The rebuilding of the east side begins on 30 November.
timeline.zh: 11 月 30 日，东六环改造工程开工。

timeline.en: The East Sixth Ring tunnel opens on 20 April.
timeline.zh: 4 月 20 日，东六环隧道开通试运营。

timeline.en: The first 1.7 km of the park on the old east-side viaduct opens on 29 April.
timeline.zh: 4 月 29 日，原东六环高架上的公园首段 1.7 公里开放。
